properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: TrimNeck
properties.description: Length of the collar between the duct and the equipment port (or the transition from it). 0 uses a quarter of the duct

properties.name: FanConnection
properties.description: How the duct leaves the unit's fan, for its system-effect loss. Only the choices that suit the connection are offered: None alone until the end is on an equipment port that discharges into the duct; a transition only where the outlet and the duct differ (sides straight or asymmetric when one side changes, pyramidal when both do or the shape changes). The transition choices also shape the transition drawn from the fan outlet to the duct

properties.name: FanOutletWidth
properties.description: Width of the fan outlet, read from the equipment port the duct end is connected to (a round port gives its diameter). 0 while the end is on no equipment port

properties.name: FanOutletHeight
properties.description: Height of the fan outlet, read from the equipment port the duct end is connected to (a round port gives its diameter). 0 while the end is on no equipment port

properties.name: TransitionAngle
properties.description: Included angle of the transition from the equipment port (or fan outlet) to the duct

properties.name: FanWheel
properties.description: Fan wheel, for Discharge into casing
